description: This file contains unit tests for the SubscriptionActor class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies behaviors such as handling empty results, multiple pages, cancellation, failures, partial failures, and timeouts within the SubscriptionActor using Akka Streams and JUnit.

classes.name: SubscriptionActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the SubscriptionActor in various scenarios such as empty results, pagination, cancellation, errors, and timeouts.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem with a specific configuration before each test.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: emptyResults
methods.description: Tests the behavior of SubscriptionActor when it receives no results.

methods.name: twoPages
methods.description: Tests the handling of multiple pages of results.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Tests the handling of a runtime exception during subscription.

methods.name: partialFailure
methods.description: Tests partial failure when some data sources fail lazily.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Tests timeout behavior of the SubscriptionActor.

methods.name: newSubscriptionActor
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionActor with a specified timeout for testing.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection between a subscription actor and a source of pages.
